rules: A milestone earns 10 points only when every condition is PASS with existing evidence. Conditions are PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL, BLOCKED or UNTESTED. Progress counts PASS conditions only; it is not a success probability.

conditions.text: One implementation branch; protocol contract and no-hardcode guard pass in CI
TypeScript and Python share one generated protocol, checked for drift
Required tests fail the gate when prerequisites are missing: end-to-end guarded in CI; companion suites on Linux, macOS and Windows fail on any skip not allowed for that OS (CI run 40 green)
Shipped web and companion dependencies have no known vulnerabilities (CI-enforced)
Sandbox, secret scan, STOP and confirmation invariants have regression tests
The frozen companion (939 files) and the installer built from an independently rebuilt bundle are byte-identical (CI run 42, Windows runner)
Pairing, signed requests and revocation refuse forged or revoked devices
Grants, RLS and cross-account isolation hold in the database
MCP workers are pinned, schema-checked, isolated and crash-safe
Journal, idempotency and lost-ACK reconciliation never repeat an effect
STOP fences dispatch and ends in-flight process trees on every OS
Take Over and resume: nothing that changes state runs before a fresh observation; stale web selectors refused
Companion killed mid-write and restarted: the write is reported unknown/interrupted and never re-run
Self-contained installer builds and every frozen worker starts
conditions.reason: Windows Server runner: builds reproducibly, every frozen worker starts; the installed companion could start no worker until 947ceee (found by the lifecycle test); unsigned (signing excluded by owner)

conditions.text: Clean install, first launch and pairing on consumer Windows 10/11
conditions.reason: needs a consumer Windows desktop or VM

conditions.text: Missing task dependencies are detected and installed only after authorization, then verified
conditions.reason: system.inspect reports OS, architecture, disk and program locations before and after a confirmed install; no journaled resumable installer, integrity/licence resolution or clean-machine tests

conditions.text: Upgrade, repair, rollback and uninstall keep customer files
conditions.reason: install, reinstall (repair) and uninstall keep the person's files on the Windows runner; upgrade between versions and rollback untested (one version exists)

conditions.text: Web targets are observation-scoped, row-disambiguated, stale references refused
Site binding, redirects, popups, sign-in hand-off and injected text handled
Windows UIA control with exact window leases and wrong-target refusal
conditions.reason: Windows Server runner only; consumer desktop, DPI and multi-monitor untested

conditions.text: macOS accessibility control
conditions.reason: not implemented

conditions.text: Linux X11/Wayland desktop control
conditions.reason: not implemented

conditions.text: Image-based target matching with confidence and stale-image checks
conditions.reason: window image and control boxes go to the model; no template matching or confidence score

conditions.text: At least 90% first-attempt verified success on unseen representative tasks
conditions.reason: unseen randomized eval, first attempt on valid tasks: seed 11 7/10, seed 12 9/11, seed 13 9/11, seed 14 2/4 = 27/36 (75%); below 90%

conditions.text: Facts and addresses come from observations; unseen deep URLs refused
Repeated steps and repeated runs of steps stop the task
Target-selection accuracy measured against hidden expected targets
Completion requires independently observed postconditions
A model never edits customer files to satisfy a wrong check
conditions.reason: instruction added; no enforcement and no live retest

conditions.text: Originals kept; newer edits never overwritten; outputs never replace files
Verifier checks semantics for documents, spreadsheets, images, video and code repairs
conditions.reason: files, workbook cells, documents, renders, measured media and well-formedness of repaired code/config (file_parses, never executed) are checked; a repaired program is not re-run by the verifier, by design

conditions.text: Every page, control and state transition inventoried and tested
conditions.reason: every reachable page audited in Chromium (desktop and phone: status, console/page errors, h1, lang, alt, accessible names), signed out in CI and signed in locally; individual controls and state transitions are not all exercised

conditions.text: Approval shows the exact operation and arguments
Install, sign in, pair, grant and first task without developer help
conditions.reason: sign-in, pairing through Settings > Devices, grants, the online-agreement dialog, task start, goal compilation and the first device step verified on staging through the website; the task then waited on the busy provider, so a completed first task is not yet verified

conditions.text: Server keys never reach workers, commands, pages or logs
conditions.reason: worker env sanitized and tested; no end-to-end secret canary test

conditions.text: Database backup restored in a drill
conditions.reason: a restore drill needs the hosted project's backup/restore controls on a disposable copy; not available without owner approval

conditions.text: Customer-readable diagnostic report (ocade_agent diagnose): pairing, workspace, server, engines, MCP manifests, every worker, STOP
Model provider capacity sustains real use without the planner going busy mid-task
conditions.reason: the shared staging Gemini project rate-limits after roughly 30-60 calls in a short window; three resumes over 15 minutes stayed busy. Raising capacity is a provider plan/spending decision for the owner; keys are not rotated to evade it

conditions.text: Every advertised OS/architecture qualified on representative hardware
conditions.reason: no consumer Windows, macOS or Linux desktop hardware

conditions.text: Median and p95 task latency measured against targets
conditions.reason: measured on 36 real Gemini tasks (Linux, staging): median 39.0 s, p95 79.7 s end to end, median 6 model calls; no owner-agreed latency targets yet, and Windows/macOS not measured

conditions.text: Unseen real-task acceptance suite at 90% or more, all gates closed
conditions.reason: depends on milestones 1-9
